description.value:
Personal Small 4-Legged Ground Drone. A small four-legged spider drone, 100m from your Neuroport (or from an access point you're into), 24 hours a charge. Cloaks as an Action (DV21 Perception to see it; attacking or touching a device drops it). Immune to EMP, electrocution and Microwavers; climbs anything, ceilings included; Lynx Paws; two manipulator arms with an Interface Plug, Gang Jazzler, techtool and techscanner; radar/sonar and radar detector; camera with LL/IR/UV and MicroVideo. Modes: Standby, Direct Control (from your Neuroport), Auto (stays within 6m and warns you of anything its sensors pick up), Leapfrog Link (plugged into an access point, anyone linked to it jacks into that architecture as if they were there; it can't move or dodge).

Cost: 25,000eb
MOVE: 8
HP: 20
Counter: DV21 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter
